dog.description_text:
Pop Up Promo! ACC is over capacity, so I'm currently living in a pop up crate. My adoption fee is waived, and my adoption comes with a $50 Chewy gift card.

Meet Karma Chameleon!

Karma Chameleon was found tied to a pole and is now ready to turn the page and find someone to call his own. He can be a little shy when first meeting someone, but give him some treats and a gentle approach and he warms up quickly. Once he gets comfortable, this young guy is social, enthusiastic, and very happy to be around his people. Give him a little time and you'll see his true colors shine!

My Ideal Home

Karma would love a patient family who will let him settle in at his own pace. He'll need plenty of daily walks, play, enrichment, and positive training to keep his young mind and body happily occupied.

Good with Other Pets?

We don't yet know how he feels about living with other dogs. His history is unknown, and any introductions should be handled slowly and carefully when he is ready.

Good with Kids?

Karma would do best in a home without very young children under 5. He can be initially fearful and gets very excited around treats, so older kids who understand how to give him space may be a better fit.

Things to Know

Karma is a fantastic loose leash walker and approaches people readily once he feels comfortable. He does have some enthusiastic puppy energy and can jump up persistently when he thinks treats are involved, so he'll need a little help learning to keep his paws on the floor. His family should also let him approach new people and handling situations at his own pace and never force him into an interaction that makes him uncomfortable.
